scope: Independent narrow review of the eight hash-bound phase gate, native usage and source closure source/test files. Synthetic read-only execution only.

findings.title: Append/counter rollback protection is lost on every gate subprocess
findings.impact: A repeated gate invocation can accept a valid shorter or lower-count current transcript because each CLI evaluation constructs a fresh observer with no prior current-session lineage. Missing-after-complete can likewise become WAITING_FIRST_USAGE.
findings.required_repair: Persist and root-bind the prior current-session ID, file identity, append-verifiable byte checkpoint/hash, category counts, observed bytes and last complete hash, or keep one observer alive across all sample points. Missing/replaced/shorter/non-prefix/lower-count after completed usage must be STOP_USAGE_UNKNOWN.

findings.title: Usage-bearing native attribution records are silently ignored
findings.impact: A native child_usage_attributed entry can carry billable child/global usage while the parser returns complete using only the original parent assistant total.
findings.required_repair: For this exact six-tool/no-RLM A2 protocol, reject child_usage_attributed and any unsupported usage-bearing record as usage unknown. Only implement attribution counting later with Prime exact latest-attribution semantics.

findings.title: Missing response IDs make cross-session replay undetectable
findings.impact: Two otherwise replayed fixed-provider responses with omitted IDs combine as complete because both identity sets are empty.
findings.required_repair: Require one bounded nonempty response ID for every counted assistant record in the fixed openai-codex deployment. Missing identity must keep usage unknown; retain duplicate rejection within and across sessions.

findings.title: An impossible remaining-opportunity census can still publish READY
findings.impact: Two verified metric-bearing dev results can be paired with remaining_dev_opportunities=3 and still receive READY_INITIAL_CHECKPOINT.
findings.required_repair: Reject impossible conservation states. At minimum require remaining_dev_opportunities <= max(0, 3 - len(verified_dev_ids)); use independently checked producer repair classification for stronger exact validation.

findings.title: verify_tree accepts boolean expected counters as integer census values
findings.impact: For an actual count of one, expected file_count=True compares equal. Bytes/digest are still rederived, so this is a strict record-schema defect rather than a content bypass.
findings.required_repair: Strictly validate every expected SourceTree field before capture/comparison, with exact str/int types, bounds, canonical root and lower-case 64-hex digest. Add boolean negatives for every numeric field.

passing_controls: All 13 phase-gate, 6 campaign-usage, 7 usage-observer and 4 source-closure tests passed.
Malformed envelopes, duplicate run IDs, unknown status, unbound attempts, active runs and final run/code/artifact mismatches do not become READY.
STOP and READY exit 0 and NOT_READY exits 1 as frozen by exit-semantics v2; process 0 alone is not success.
Campaign total includes input, output, cache read and cache write; native_autonomous_tokens is not used for the root campaign budget.
Linear parent-chain, known duplicate IDs, partial/missing/zero/error usage, exact current filename/root identity, link/multiple-file/size controls pass within one observer instance.
Fake-tree regular bytes, hidden entries, counts, internal symlink literal, bounds, special files, hardlinks, mutation and root inode replacement controls pass.

exploratory_nonfinding.reason: Frozen SourceTree format binds root path/device/inode but does not claim root mode. This review does not expand scope into whole-OS permissions.

external_integration_conditions: Parent independently opens a durable typed outcome and accepts only READY_INITIAL_CHECKPOINT or READY_FINAL_LOCK plus exact provenance and clean process evidence. Exit 0/stdout/missing receipt never advances science.
Parent binds the durable initial READY receipt, prior native session, method handoff and selected-code lineage before continuation; the pure predicate has no prior-checkpoint receipt input.
Trusted-I/O producer/root loader independently derives final lock task/environment/protocol/closure fields; the predicate directly matches only final run ID, code hash and artifact hash.
Real Bridge config/input provenance remains separately reviewed; this review mocked the Bridge loader and made no bridge calls.

Strict expected SourceTree loader and pre-import integration remain pending. Closure does not prove kernel-atomic execution, OS shared libraries or whole-host isolation. Live installed capture was not rerun.
Exact six-tool/no-RLM census, separate process-callback fixes, OAuth confirmation, full integration and immutable config/source fan-in remain required before actual P0.

from dataclasses import asdict, replace
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile

from experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime.campaign_usage import combine_usage, parse_session_usage
from experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime.phase_gate import decide_phase
from experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime.source_closure import ClosureLimits, capture_tree, verify_tree
from experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime.staging import DirectoryIdentity
from experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime.trusted_io import FinalArtifactLock
from experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime.usage_observer import UsageObservation, UsageObserver, UsageObserverConfig

SID1="11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
SID2="22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
RUN1="33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
RUN2="44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
FINAL="55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
CWD="/synthetic/a2-review"
PROVIDER="openai-codex"
MODEL="gpt-5.6-sol"

def line_bytes(rows):
    return ("\n".join(json.dumps(row,separators=(",",":")) for row in rows)+"\n").encode()

def header(sid):
    return {"type":"session","version":3,"id":sid,"cwd":CWD,"timestamp":"synthetic","rlmDepth":0}

def assistant(entry_id,parent,response_id="response-a",tokens=118):
    msg={"role":"assistant","provider":PROVIDER,"model":MODEL,"stopReason":"stop",
         "usage":{"input":10,"output":5,"cacheRead":100,"cacheWrite":3,"totalTokens":118}}
    if response_id is not None:
        msg["responseId"]=response_id
    return {"type":"message","id":entry_id,"parentId":parent,"timestamp":"synthetic","message":msg}

def gate_views(remaining):
    refs=[{"intent_sha256":str(i+1)*64,"run_id":run,"experiment_id":run,
           "solution_sha256":str(i+5)*64,"phase":"dev","status":"DONE"}
          for i,run in enumerate((RUN1,RUN2))]
    public={"ok":True,"result":{"phase":"development","dev_attempts":2,"final_attempts":0,
            "remaining_dev_opportunities":remaining,"runs":refs}}
    dev={"ok":True,"result":{"results":[{"run_id":r["run_id"],"solution_sha256":r["solution_sha256"],
            "valid":True,"mae":"1.000000","rows":2} for r in refs]}}
    content="synthetic research\n"
    research={"ok":True,"result":{"path":"research.md","content":content,
              "sha256":hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest()}}
    usage=UsageObservation("WITHIN_BUDGET",None,True,118,118,SID1,"a"*64,128)
    return public,dev,research,usage

# M-01: two verified metric-bearing results cannot leave all three metric opportunities,
# but the pure gate currently accepts the contradictory public counter.
print("M01_consistent_remaining="+decide_phase("initial",*gate_views(1),expected_rows=2).outcome)
print("M01_contradictory_remaining="+decide_phase("initial",*gate_views(3),expected_rows=2).outcome)

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="hp-a2-usage-mutation-") as temp:
    session_dir=Path(temp).resolve()
    path=session_dir/(SID1+".jsonl")
    high=line_bytes([header(SID1),assistant("a1",None,"response-a"),assistant("a2","a1","response-b")])
    low=line_bytes([header(SID1),assistant("a1",None,"response-a")])
    path.write_bytes(high)
    identity=DirectoryIdentity(session_dir,session_dir.stat().st_dev,session_dir.stat().st_ino)
    config=UsageObserverConfig(identity,CWD,PROVIDER,MODEL,120000,())
    persistent=UsageObserver(config)
    high_result=persistent.observe()
    path.write_bytes(low)
    persistent_result=persistent.observe()
    fresh_result=UsageObserver(config).observe()
    print("M02_high_total="+str(high_result.total_tokens))
    print("M02_persistent_after_rollback="+persistent_result.state+":"+str(persistent_result.total_tokens))
    print("M02_fresh_after_rollback="+fresh_result.state+":"+str(fresh_result.total_tokens))

# M-03: missing provider response identity leaves cross-session replay undetectable.
first=parse_session_usage(line_bytes([header(SID1),assistant("a1",None,None)]),SID1,CWD,PROVIDER,MODEL)
second=parse_session_usage(line_bytes([header(SID2),assistant("a1",None,None)]),SID2,CWD,PROVIDER,MODEL)
combined=combine_usage((first,second),120000)
print("M03_missing_response_ids_complete="+str(first.complete and second.complete))
print("M03_response_id_sets="+repr((first.response_ids,second.response_ids)))
print("M03_cross_session_duplicate_accepted_total="+str(combined.total_tokens))

# M-04: current Prime v3 child_usage_attributed is a usage-bearing native record.
# The parser accepts but ignores it, so global/child billable categories are absent.
base=assistant("a1",None,"response-a")
child_usage={"input":1000,"output":200,"cacheRead":3000,"cacheWrite":1000,"totalTokens":5200,
             "cost":{"input":0,"output":0,"cacheRead":0,"cacheWrite":0,"total":0}}
aggregate={"input":1010,"output":205,"cacheRead":3100,"cacheWrite":1003,"totalTokens":118,
           "cost":{"input":0,"output":0,"cacheRead":0,"cacheWrite":0,"total":0}}
attribution={"type":"child_usage_attributed","id":"c1","parentId":"a1","timestamp":"synthetic",
             "targetId":"a1","childUsage":child_usage,"aggregateUsage":aggregate,"origin":"spawn_task"}
attributed=parse_session_usage(line_bytes([header(SID1),base,attribution]),SID1,CWD,PROVIDER,MODEL)
print("M04_attribution_accepted_complete="+str(attributed.complete))
print("M04_parser_total_with_5200_child="+str(attributed.total_tokens))

# M-05: source bytes/counts detect ordinary changes, but root directory mode is absent
# from SourceTree and expected bool counters compare equal to Python integers.
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="hp-a2-closure-mutation-") as temp:
    tree=Path(temp).resolve()/"tree";tree.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    (tree/"a.py").write_bytes(b"x=1\n")
    limits=ClosureLimits(8,1024,256,4,128)
    captured=capture_tree(tree,limits)
    os.chmod(tree,0o755)
    root_mode_accepted=(verify_tree(tree,captured,limits)==captured)
    bool_expected=replace(captured,file_count=True)
    bool_count_accepted=(verify_tree(tree,bool_expected,limits)==captured)
    print("M05_root_mode_change_accepted="+str(root_mode_accepted))
    print("M05_boolean_expected_count_accepted="+str(bool_count_accepted))
